title: Lucky Clover
body:
Description


Lucky clover was sold in The Oak Depot for $1,002 during the 2023 St. Patrick's day and has 2 variations. First is with 3 leaves and the rarer version is with 4 leaves (believed to be 1/50 or 1/100 chance).

Item Description: "Let's be honest, these developers are really annoying. They probably added some super rare 4 leaf version, dang it."

Now, they can be found all over Finlay island. Each costing $75 per clover.
